svg.text: GELU, its gate and its slope, from x = -4 to 4
Left: the forward, y = x · p(x), next to ReLU. Right: the gate p and the slope gelu'(x) the backward multiplies dy by.
Dots: the example values x = 1, -1, 2, -2. The slope goes above 1 near x = 1.42 and below 0 near x = -1.42: ReLU’s slope never does.
